text:
alex: heads up — seeing recurring ECC/Xid spikes on cluster-12 (us-west-2) GPUs. three cards flagged, node r12-gpu-07 already drained. suspect flaky nvlink on two. serials below:
```
SN: NV-47A9-00123
SN: NV-47A9-00456
SN: NV-47A9-00901
```
need RMA + depot swap logistics — any spare capacity in LAX or nearby? vendor SLA 48h.

maria: are the affected pods already evacuated? any live jobs lost?

alex: pods migrated successfully via pod-evict, only one batch job hit a retry window. no data loss. drain done at 1719001300. opened ticket with vendor (RMA-93812).

opsbot: [automated] RMA ticket created: RMA-93812 with NimbusGPU. Vendor ETA: 48h. Depot swap queued. Please attach serial photos & manifest.

jordan: LAX spares = 1x A100-80GB. ORD has 2 spares. If vendor wants depot swap, we can parcel via same-day courier to LAX depot and hand off there. LAX spare could be rotated into node in ~2h.

li: vendor requires serial list + kitting manifest and a photo of both sides. also need to reconcile asset tags in inventory. sample manifest format I prefer:
```
serial,asset_tag,model,location
NV-47A9-00123,ASSET-8812,A100-80GB,LAX-DEPOT-2
NV-47A9-00456,ASSET-8820,A100-80GB,CLUSTER-12
```
Do we need original packaging? vendor note says optional but better for crossdock.

alex: will take photos + upload to ticket. packaging: we have secondary anti-static boxes at LAX. should be ok.

maria: cost for courier overnight? ops budget approval needed if >$200. if under, charge ops-capex-urgent. @jordan can you confirm estimate?

jordan: same-day LAX pickup estimate ~$95 using company UPS acct. I'll submit cost tag once courier scheduled. planning handoff window 09:00-11:00 PT tomorrow.

opsbot: [update] Courier pickup scheduled: 2024-05-03 09:00 PT. Tracking: https://courier.example/track/1Z999AA10123456784

jordan: I'll meet courier at LAX depot, swap in spare, tag old cards for return manifest. plan: rotate spare into r12-gpu-07, reprovision via infra-ansible, then update inventory. command to tag returned cards:
```
invctl tag --serial NV-47A9-00123 --status for-return --location LAX-DEPOT-2
```
Please don't dispatch to vendor until photos + manifest attached.

alex: got it. I'll upload photos to RMA-93812 and confirm when handed to courier. thanks all :thumbsup:
